label: Companion animal
definition: An animal kept as a companion in the household.

label: Dog
definition: A domestic dog (Canis familiaris).

label: Cat
definition: A domestic cat (Felis catus). Breed is not asserted for the named cats in this corpus.

label: Rabbit
definition: A domestic rabbit.

label: Flat-Coated Retriever
definition: A gundog breed with a flat, dense coat.

label: Dutch rabbit
definition: A rabbit breed typically marked with a white blaze and saddle and colored cheeks and hindquarters.

label: Rex rabbit
definition: A rabbit breed known for a short, plush rex coat.

label: Coat color
definition: A named coat color.

label: Coat pattern
definition: A named distribution of color on the coat (not a breed).

label: has coat color
definition: Associates an animal with a coat color. An animal may have more than one.

label: has coat pattern
definition: Associates an animal with a coat pattern such as calico or cow (bicolor).

label: Sex
definition: Sex of a companion animal, recorded only when asserted.

label: Female
definition: Female sex.

label: Male
definition: Male sex.

label: has sex
definition: Associates an animal with an asserted sex.

label: has age in years
definition: Age in years, recorded only when asserted.

label: has preferred feeding hour
definition: Preferred meal hour in local 24-hour time (e.g. 18 for 6pm).

label: has minimum warm-up hours
definition: Typical minimum hours this animal needs to warm up to a person, unless acceleratesWarmUpUsing applies.

label: has maximum warm-up hours
definition: Typical maximum hours this animal needs to warm up to a stranger or new person.

label: Treat
definition: A food item used to capture attention or reward.

label: Temptations
definition: Temptations brand cat treats. Favored by Salem and Stevie; shaking the tub speeds Salem's warm-up with people.

label: Food
definition: A meal food, distinct from a treat.

label: Aussie wet food
definition: Aussie brand wet food. Favored by Stevie and Lilo. Lilo's primary affection motivation.

label: Chicken
definition: Chicken as food. Asserted as something Lilo strongly loves.

label: Wet food
definition: Household wet food (unspecified brand). Asserted as a primary motivation for Vader.

label: Dry food
definition: Dry food. Asserted as something Q loves.

label: Treats
definition: Treats in general. Asserted as a primary motivation for Vader.

label: has low motivation for
definition: The animal is not strongly motivated by this treat or food, relative to their favorites.

label: will accept
definition: The animal will take this item even if it is not a primary motivation.

label: has favored food
definition: A meal food this animal especially loves.

label: Temperament
definition: A standing behavioral trait.

label: has temperament
definition: Associates an animal with a standing behavioral trait.

label: Energetic
definition: Energetic temperament.

label: Playful
definition: Playful temperament.

label: Extremely shy with strangers
definition: Very wary of unfamiliar people.

label: Overtly affectionate
definition: Gives and demands affection so strongly that a person may need a protocol to end the session.

label: Demanding of pets
definition: Will keep requesting pets after a person wants to stop.

label: Fun
definition: Fun temperament.

label: Loving
definition: Loving temperament.

label: Loves people immediately
definition: Warms up to people at once; no long stranger delay.

label: Not aggressive
definition: Not an aggressive animal.

label: Unaware of own size
definition: Does not act as if they realize how large they are.

label: Nervous around other dogs
definition: Unsure how to act or how other dogs will react; cautious until comfortable, still observantly anxious.

label: Sketched out by large vehicles
definition: Unsettled by large vehicles.

label: Confident
definition: Confident temperament.

label: Shy at first
definition: Nervous and shy initially, then more open.

label: Requires consent for touch
definition: Does not love being touched unless they have invited it.

label: Affectionate
definition: Affectionate temperament.

label: Warm
definition: Warm temperament.

label: Hungry
definition: Often food-focused; loves to eat.

label: Primarily food motivated
definition: Food is the main motivation.

label: Stimulus
definition: Something in the environment that can unsettle or interest an animal.

label: is nervous around
definition: Associates an animal with a stimulus they are nervous around.

label: Large vehicles
definition: Large vehicles as a stimulus.

label: Other dogs
definition: Other dogs as a stimulus.

label: Stairs
definition: Staircases. Asserted as something Q is not a big fan of.

label: Place
definition: A location an animal may enjoy or avoid.

label: enjoys place
definition: Associates an animal with a place they love.

label: Sunny windowsill
definition: A sunlit windowsill. Asserted as a place Q loves.

label: requests meal using
definition: How the animal captures attention when a preferred meal time is missed or late.

label: has favored treat
definition: A treat this animal is especially responsive to.

label: accelerates warm-up using
definition: This method shortens the animal's usual warm-up time with people.

label: Shaking a treat tub
definition: Shaking a tub of treats to capture attention and speed social warm-up.

label: Orange
definition: Orange (red) coat color.

label: Black
definition: Black coat color.

label: White
definition: White coat color.

label: Calico
definition: A tri-color coat pattern, typically patches of orange, black, and white. Not a breed.

label: Cow cat
definition: A black-and-white bicolor coat pattern, informally called a cow cat. Not a breed.

label: Attention-for-affection method
definition: A way of capturing attention whose intended outcome is maximum affection. May be initiated by the animal or by a person.

label: solicits affection using
definition: The animal uses this method to capture a person's attention in order to receive affection.

label: prefers affection via
definition: A person is most likely to get this animal's attention and give affection successfully by using this method.

label: Vocalizing
definition: Using voice (bark, meow, honk, cluck) to capture attention for affection.

label: Nudging
definition: Pushing the head or body against a person to capture attention for affection.

label: Pawing
definition: Using a paw or forefoot on a person or nearby surface to capture attention for affection.

label: Leaning
definition: Leaning body weight against a person to capture attention for affection.

label: Following
definition: Staying with or trailing a person to keep attention available for affection.

label: Occupying lap
definition: Sitting or lying on a person's lap to capture attention and receive affection.

label: Presenting belly
definition: Exposing the underside to invite attention and affection (acceptance varies by individual).

label: Bringing an object
definition: Delivering a toy or other object to capture attention for interaction and affection.

label: Direct gaze
definition: Looking at a person to capture attention for affection.

label: Slow blink
definition: A relaxed, slow blink used to capture or return affiliative attention, especially with cats.

label: Sitting close
definition: Settling nearby without contact to keep attention available for affection.

label: Chin presenting
definition: Offering the chin or cheeks for scritches as a bid for affection.

label: Flopping
definition: A sudden side-flop or stretch-out that captures attention and can invite calm affection, often in rabbits.

label: Loafing
definition: Tucking the feet under the body in a loaf pose; with eye contact and teeth chittering can be a bid for pets.

label: Teeth chittering
definition: Softly chattering or grinding teeth as an affiliative bid, often while loafing and making eye contact.

label: Feet sticking out
definition: Resting with hind feet stretched out; a contentment posture. Asserted as when Jules is most content.

label: Head rub
definition: Rubs on the head.

label: Neck rub
definition: Rubs on the neck.

label: Shoulder rub
definition: Rubs on the shoulders.

label: Gentle back kneading
definition: Gentle kneading along the back.

label: Gentle side-belly kneading
definition: Gentle kneading on the side of the belly.

label: blocks from eating
definition: Tries to keep another animal from accessing food.

label: steals treats from
definition: Takes treats intended for another animal.

label: is sometimes upset by
definition: Is sometimes upset by the other animal's actions (e.g. food blocking or treat stealing).

label: Circling
definition: Circling a person's feet or legs to capture attention for affection.

label: Getting on their level
definition: A person sits or kneels to the animal's height to capture attention for maximum affection.

label: Quiet approach
definition: A person approaches slowly and with little noise so the animal will accept attention and affection.

label: Preferred-spot scratch
definition: A person scratches a favored spot (e.g. chest, chin, base of ears) to capture attention and maximize affection.

label: Offering a treat
definition: Using food to capture attention as a prelude to affection; not a substitute for the affection itself.

label: Clawing
definition: Using claws on a person as an aggressive bid to capture attention for affection.

label: Gentle biting
definition: A light or inhibited bite used as a bid to capture attention for affection.

label: Vigorous petting
definition: A person uses firm, energetic petting (aggressive pets) to give affection.

label: Sprawling on lap
definition: Fully stretching or sprawling across a person's lap to capture attention for affection, beyond merely sitting.

label: Vigorous belly rub
definition: Firm, energetic rubbing of the belly.

label: Light chin scratch
definition: Gentle scratching under the chin.

label: Light cheek scratch
definition: Gentle scratching of the cheeks.

label: Toy
definition: An object used in play or to signal a request.

label: Outing-request method
definition: A way of capturing a person's attention in order to go outside. Distinct from affection bids.

label: has favorite toy
definition: The toy this animal prefers.

label: requests going outside using
definition: The animal uses this method to capture attention when he or she wants to go outside.

label: Bringing a toy to go outside
definition: Bringing a toy to a person to capture attention because the animal wants to go outside.

label: Halloween cat toy
definition: A short, round Halloween cat toy. Asserted as Vader's favorite toy.

label: Feather wand
definition: A feather wand toy. Asserted as one of Salem's biggest motivations.

label: has primary motivation
definition: A strongest day-to-day motivation (toy or treat). Asserted only when stated.

label: Retreat
definition: A place an animal withdraws to.

label: has retreat
definition: Associates an animal with a retreat.

label: is affectionate upon leaving
definition: The animal is warm and affectionate after coming out of this retreat.

label: Bat cave
definition: Salem's retreat. She is warm and affectionate when she comes out of it.

label: Play activity
definition: A play or climbing activity an animal is known to do.

label: enjoys play activity
definition: Associates an animal with a play or climbing activity they do or love.

label: Scaling Christmas trees
definition: Climbing up a Christmas tree. Asserted of Salem.

label: Swinging on the cat-tree pole
definition: Swinging around the pole of a cat tree. Asserted as something Salem loves.

label: Walks
definition: Going on walks. Asserted as something Vader loves.

label: Running around the backyard
definition: Running in the backyard. Asserted as something Vader loves.

label: Backyard belly rubs
definition: Lying in the backyard while getting belly rubs. Asserted as something Vader loves.

label: Being called a handsome boy
definition: A person calls him a handsome boy. Asserted as something Vader loves.

label: Play-request method
definition: A way of capturing a person's attention in order to play.

label: requests play using
definition: The animal uses this method to capture attention when they want to play.

label: Bringing a toy to play
definition: Dragging or bringing a toy to a person because the animal wants to play.

label: Stevie's feather wand
definition: Stevie's feather wand toy. She drags it to a person when she wants to play.

label: Fabric
definition: A textile type.

label: Fleece
definition: Fleece fabric. Asserted as Stevie's favorite.

label: has favorite fabric
definition: The fabric this animal prefers.

label: Comfort item
definition: A household item that can make an animal more willing to give affection.

label: Fleece blanket
definition: A fleece blanket. Stevie is more affectionate when one is handy.

label: Fleece robe
definition: A fleece robe. Stevie is more affectionate when one is handy.

label: increases affection when present
definition: The animal is more inclined to be affectionate when this item is handy.

label: Having fleece handy
definition: A person has a fleece blanket or robe available, which increases some animals' willingness to give affection.

label: Sitting at a distance
definition: Sitting somewhat apart, possibly awkwardly, rather than close contact.

label: Head bonk
definition: Bumping the head against a person as a bid for pets.

label: Heavying the body
definition: Making the body dead-weight to stay in contact and resist being moved.

label: Resisting displacement
definition: Bracing or refusing to be relocated when a person wants less contact.

label: Desperate clawing
definition: Intense clawing at a person's body to keep or regain contact.

label: escalates when affection withdrawn early
definition: Behaviors that appear if a person has been giving a lot of affection and then stops before the animal is ready.

label: Attention-cessation method
definition: A way a person ends an affection session when the animal is still demanding pets.

label: stops demanding attention via
definition: A protocol a person uses to end demanded pets.

label: has cessation repetitions min
definition: Minimum times a cessation method is typically repeated.

label: has cessation repetitions max
definition: How many times a cessation method (e.g. midbody launch) typically must be repeated before the animal stops demanding pets.

label: Midbody launch protocol
definition: Gently unhook claws from fabrics, then launch the cat off by the midbody in a firm manner. Repeat typically 3-5 times. Asserted that Alfred enjoys being launched and the following hunt of despair.

label: Verbal settle protocol
definition: Firmly but lightly push the cat off, settle his body down, and say: dude stay enough of this.

label: Being launched
definition: Being firmly launched midbody off a person. Asserted as something Alfred enjoys.

label: Hunt of despair
definition: The chase or hunt that follows being launched. Asserted as something Alfred loves, which is why the launch protocol must be repeated.

label: Christmas tree
definition: A household Christmas tree that can be climbed.

label: Cat-tree pole
definition: The vertical pole of a cat tree, used for climbing or swinging.

label: Vader
definition: A specific 5-year-old Flat-Coated Retriever. Fun, loving, and energetic. Loves people immediately. Sketched out by large vehicles. Nervous around other dogs: unsure how to act or how they will react; cautious until comfortable, still observantly anxious. Loves walks and running around the backyard. Loves being called a handsome boy. Loves lying in the backyard getting belly rubs. Lives for treats and wet food. Prefers to be fed around 6pm and will bark endlessly if food is not getting ready then. Not aggressive. Unaware of how large he is. Brings toys (favorite: short round Halloween cat) when he wants to go outside.

label: Alfred
definition: A specific 10-year-old male orange cat. Overtly affectionate to the point that a person needs a protocol to stop demanded pets. If given a lot of affection and stopped before he is ready, he claws and bites, heavies his body, resists moving, and desperately claws at the person. Proper protocol: gently unhook claws from fabrics and launch via midbody firmly; he enjoys being launched and the hunt of despair, so this typically takes 3-5 times. Alternative: firmly but lightly push him off, settle his body, and say dude stay enough of this.

label: Salem
definition: A specific female cat, five years old, with black coat color. She readily presents her belly. She loves vigorous belly rubs and light chin and cheek scratches. She is warm and affectionate when she comes out of her bat cave. Biggest motivations are the feather wand toy and Temptations treats. She can be found scaling Christmas trees and loves swinging around the cat-tree pole. She typically needs at least six hours to warm up to people unless a tub of Temptations is shaken. Bids include sprawling on a person's lap.

label: Stevie
definition: A specific female cat, five years old, with a cow-cat (black-and-white bicolor) pattern. Extremely shy with strangers. Energetic and playful. She loves her feather wand and drags it to a person when she wants to play. She loves Temptations treats and Aussie wet food. Fleece is her favorite fabric; she is more inclined to be affectionate if a fleece blanket or robe is handy.

label: Lilo
definition: A specific female calico cat, around ten years old. Strongly motivated by chicken and Aussie wet food; wet food is her primary affection motivation. Not strongly motivated by Temptations but will accept them. Prefers to sit awkwardly at a distance and head-bonks when she wants pets. Warm-up to strangers is under an hour.

label: Q
definition: A specific 3-year-old male Dutch rabbit. Confident but nervous and shy at first. Does not love being touched unless he invited it. When he wants pets he flops nearby or loafs, makes eye contact, and chitters his teeth. Loves treats and dry food. Loves a sunny windowsill. Not a big fan of stairs. Sometimes upset when Jules blocks him from eating or steals his treats.

label: Jules
definition: A specific 2-year-old female Rex rabbit. Affectionate, warm, and hungry. Primarily food motivated; loves to eat. Will try to block Q from eating and steal his treats; Q is sometimes upset by this. Most content with her feet sticking out. Loves rubs on her head, neck, and shoulder, and gentle kneading on her back and side belly.

label: Anti-bid
definition: A cue that means do not start contact, stop contact, or the animal is protesting. Distinct from an affection bid.

label: has anti-bid
definition: An anti-bid or protest this animal is known for.

label: anti-bid triggered by
definition: A human or household action that tends to produce this anti-bid.

label: Uninvited touch
definition: Contact the animal did not invite. Asserted as something Q does not love.

label: Approaching during warm-up
definition: Pushing for contact before the animal's warm-up window. Asserted for Salem (about six hours unless Temptations tub is shaken).

label: Forced approach while shy
definition: Coming in fast or forcing contact while the animal is extremely shy with strangers. Asserted for Stevie.

label: Crowding while distant
definition: Closing distance when the animal is sitting apart as their preferred posture. Asserted for Lilo.

label: Affection withdrawn early
definition: A person gave a lot of pets then stopped before the animal was ready. Asserted as Alfred's escalation trigger (claw, bite, heavy body, desperate clawing).

label: Food blocking of cagemate
definition: Blocking another animal from food or stealing their treats. Asserted of Jules toward Q; Q is sometimes upset.

label: Reaching for food mid-meal
definition: A person reaching toward this animal's food or treats while they are eating. Asserted for Vader.

label: Cats near food
definition: Cats approaching this animal's food. Asserted that Vader will growl.

label: Being picked up
definition: Lifting the animal off the ground. Anti-bid for Vader and the rabbits except a vet emergency (Jules: also skilled fully supported handling).

label: Being scruffed
definition: Scruffing. Do not scruff the rabbits except a vet emergency.

label: Ventral belly touch
definition: Uninvited or full-belly handling. Asserted for Jules. Distinct from invited gentle side-belly kneading while her feet are out.

label: Feet tucked means stop
definition: Jules: feet sticking out means continue; tucking the feet in means stop pets.

label: Warning signal
definition: A precursor cue that contact should pause. Household-wide: tail lash/thump, ears back, freeze, walk or hop away, growl/hiss/honk, overstimulation bite.

label: shows warning
definition: A warning signal this animal is known to show.

label: Tail lash or thump
definition: Tail lash or thump as a pause-contact warning.

label: Ears back
definition: Ears back as a pause-contact warning.

label: Freeze
definition: Freezing as a pause-contact warning.

label: Walk or hop away
definition: Leaving as a pause-contact warning.

label: Growl, hiss, or honk
definition: Vocal protest. Asserted: Vader growls if cats go near his food.

label: Bite from overstimulation
definition: A bite that means stop. Connected with Alfred's protest pattern; also a household warning.

label: Recovery method
definition: What to do after an anti-bid so the animal can reset.

label: recovers via
definition: How this animal resets after a protest.

label: Giving space
definition: Step back or leave the room after a protest.

label: Offering a treat after protest
definition: Offer a treat after an anti-bid so the animal can reset.

label: Quiet sit, no reaching
definition: Sit quietly without reaching after a protest.

label: pickup permitted when
definition: Narrow exceptions to BeingPickedUp.

label: Handling exception
definition: A stated exception to pickup or scruff anti-bids.

label: Vet emergency
definition: Pickup or scruff allowed only for a veterinary emergency.

label: Skilled supported rabbit handling
definition: Handler is confident and can keep the rabbit fully supported. Jules pickup exception, not a casual pickup.
